tldr: Can a single policy-coefficient orbit computation provide exact binary shared-control equality-intersection tests and usable strong-FWER decisions for delayed multi-arm response-adaptive trials? The proposed field-level contribution is the factorial restriction of one symmetric orbit table to every outside-success-conditioned intersection, followed by observed-profile closure compression. An exact-rational delayed-Beta consumer policy and a strict nine-cell power and resource gate test its practical reach.
